installCommand: cd MenuApp-Backend && npm ci && cd ../MenuApp-Frontend && npm ci
buildCommand: cd MenuApp-Backend && npx prisma generate && if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL} npm run db:deploy; else echo 'Sin DATABASE_URL: se saltea la base de datos'; fi && cd ../MenuApp-Frontend && npm run build
